source: heydru.com for the web palette and typography (see `web`, `typography`); Figma — final HEYDRU 2021 (Copy), BRANDBOOK page (Color Styles + COLORES frame) for the 12 legacy swatches, CMYK and logos
notes: CMYK is only documented in the source for the 4 core colors (Red, Azul, Yellow, Black) — the other 8 exist only as Color Styles, no print breakdown given. Heydru-Black's HEX (#393A3E) is verified against the Color Style and against logo-dark.svg/favicon.svg; the source deck's own RGB text label for it (34,33,33) doesn't match that HEX and appears to be a typo in the original artwork, not a second valid value.

system.note: The source file lists 12 Color Styles as a flat set with no stated hierarchy or usage guidance. This grouping/ratio is our own addition (not from the 2021 source) — same idea as how mature brand systems (e.g. GitHub's: ~80% neutral, ~10% grey, ~10% hero green) assign roles so the palette reads as a system instead of 12 equal swatches.

neutral.use: surfaces, body text, structure — the dominant share of any layout

primary.use: the one hero color — CTAs, the icon mark, key emphasis. Never compete with it using a second saturated color in the same view.

accent.use: sparing use for variety, data visualization, or illustration — never as a substitute for the primary red on a CTA

derivedTints.note: Not in the source file — derived for product-UI needs (hover/active states, subtle backgrounds). Not used by the current heydru.com, whose hover and small-text reds are web.tokens.red-hover and web.tokens.red-text.

Heydru-Red-hover.use: hover/active state for red CTAs/links — a ~10% darken of Heydru-Red

Heydru-Red-wash.use: subtle tinted background, e.g. a selected row or badge, where solid red would be too loud

Heydru-Red-wash-strong.use: hover state for the wash above

ramps.note: Not in the source file. 6-step tint/shade ramps computed in HSL off the verified base hex, same idea as GitHub's brand-toolkit color ramps. Named red-NNN/neutral-NNN, deliberately distinct from the named swatches above (Heydru-Red2, Heydru-gray3/4/5) to avoid confusion.

web.note: The web UI palette as heydru.com ships it (astro/src/styles/global.css). heydru.com is the source of truth for digital work; when this block and the 2021 swatches disagree for screen use, this block wins. Dark is the default theme.

bg.use: Page background (--bg). The site is dark-first; light is the theme toggle. Never use #393a3e as a dark ground — that is light-mode ink.

surface.use: Service cards, dropdown, mobile nav panel, founder image well (--surface).

surface-raised.use: Alternating 'raised' sections, the trust strip and the cards inside them.

surface-hover.use: Hover fill for linked content cards.

surface-closing.use: Closing call-to-action band: a red-tinted ground.

header-bg.use: Sticky header fill, under an 18px backdrop blur.

text.use: Default text on bg, surface and surface-raised (17.4:1 dark, 11.4:1 light).

text-strong.use: Hero period, prose <strong>, the closing email link, button.secondary text.

prose.use: Long-form article and About body copy (12.4:1 dark).

nav.use: Desktop navigation links; hover goes to text-strong (dark) or red-text (light).

muted.use:
Paragraphs: every

defaults to muted. 8.8:1 on bg dark, 6.9:1 light.

meta.use: Uppercase card-meta labels above card titles.

faint.use: Footer column eyebrows and the visual caption under the hero art.

subtle.use: Article index numbers and the footer legal line (6.5:1 dark).

caption.use: Hero location label (5.8:1 dark) — the dimmest text the site uses; go no lower.

line.use: Every hairline: header and section borders, card-grid gutters, ruled lists. Borders, never shadows, separate things.

red.use: Heydru-Red: primary CTA fill, accent words in headings ("we step in."), arrows, status dot, process-step top rule. As text only at 24px+ in light (4.09:1 on white); 4.65:1 on bg dark.

red-text.use: Red for small text: list numbers, section index, prose links, article eyebrow, current TOC item, light-mode hover. 9.1:1 dark, 6.7:1 light.

red-step.use: Large outlined step numbers (01–04) in the process grid.

red-hover.use: Primary button background on hover (on-red text stays 9.1:1).

on-red.use: Text on a red or red-hover fill — dark ink, not white (4.65:1 on red).

red-glow.use: 4px halo ring around the status dot.

red-border.use: Top and bottom border of the closing band.

blue.use: Heydru-Azul. Declared on the site but used sparingly; never text on bg dark (2.3:1).

yellow.use: Focus ring in dark, skip-link fill, Drupal AI Engineering service art and hover border. Never text on white (1.2:1).

turquoise.use: Architecture Advisory service art and hover border. Never text on white (1.4:1).

focus.use: 2px focus outline, offset 6px on links (4px on buttons).

terminology.sintesisGrafica: icon mark alone, no wordmark (commonly called the isotipo)

logo.clearSpace: On all four sides of the marca gráfica, equal to one icon-mark's width/height, measured from the lockup's outer edges — per the source file's own guideline frames.

onDark.use: white wordmark, no icon, for dark backgrounds

onLight.use: Heydru-Black wordmark, no icon, for light backgrounds

alternateColors.note: Red is the default icon color (and the only one paired with white, for dark backgrounds). black/blue/yellow are real alternates shown in the source file's own color-variant grids (both the horizontal and the vertical one), always with black wordmark text where there's a wordmark — consistent across every form, not just one of them.

onDarkMonochrome.use: icon and wordmark both white — a separate, real option for single-ink/dark contexts, not a substitute for the two-tone onDark lockup

onDark.use: icon stacked above white wordmark, for dark backgrounds

onDarkMonochrome.use: icon and wordmark both white, icon stacked above — a separate, real option for single-ink/dark contexts

onLight.use: icon stacked above Heydru-Black wordmark, for light backgrounds

typography.adopted: Poppins 700 (display) + Roboto (body), as heydru.com ships it. The brand standard for digital work.

display.use: Headings and step numbers only. Tracking -0.045em (-0.065em on the hero); line height 1.02-1.12, 1.3 for card titles.

body.use: 16px / 1.65 body; 500 for uppercase labels; 700 for button labels.
